stories.headline: Complementarianism Explained: God's Design for Men and Women
stories.summary: The piece offers a clear, practical outline of complementarian theology, describing how men and women are intended to serve differently in church and society. It aims to strip away jargon and present God’s vision in an accessible way.

stories.headline: OpenAI Pushes GPT‑5.6 to New Price‑Performance Heights
stories.summary: OpenAI details the performance gains and cost efficiencies achieved with the upcoming GPT‑5.6 model. The article highlights architectural tweaks that deliver more output for less compute.

stories.headline: Russian Missile Barrage Kills Ten in Ukraine, One Strays into Poland
stories.summary: A coordinated Russian missile and drone attack across Ukraine killed at least ten civilians, including children. One stray missile landed in Poland, prompting NATO to scramble fighter jets.

stories.headline: Why the Bible’s Silence on Work Is Actually Guidance
stories.summary: The author argues that the Bible’s lack of explicit instructions about work is itself a directive, urging believers to infer purpose from broader principles. It suggests that vocation is to be understood through the lens of faith rather than a rulebook.

stories.headline: Fake‑Authored Papers Slip Through Peer Review, Accepted as Oral Presentations
stories.summary: Two research papers submitted with fabricated author identities were still accepted for oral presentation at a conference. The incident exposes weaknesses in current peer‑review verification processes.

stories.headline: Scaling PostgreSQL Queues for High‑Throughput Workloads
stories.summary: The blog post outlines techniques for turning PostgreSQL into a high‑performance queuing system, including partitioning and advisory locks. It demonstrates real‑world scaling results for demanding applications.

stories.headline: Vini Reilly Returns with 'Renascent' After 16‑Year Hiatus
stories.summary: After a 16‑year gap, Vini Reilly releases 'Renascent', blending minimalist guitar work with ambient textures. Critics note the album feels both nostalgic and universally resonant.

stories.headline: Singer’s Fourth Album 'I Can See' Stuck in Uniform Mid‑Tempo Drift
stories.summary: The fourth album from the singer, titled 'I Can See', settles into a consistently moderate tempo with subdued vocals. Reviewers criticize its lack of dynamic contrast, describing it as homogenously mellow.

stories.headline: U.S. Unleashes Heavy Strikes on Iran Following Attempted Assault on Troops
stories.summary: The United States has launched a series of heavy strikes against Iranian targets after an alleged attempt to attack American forces. The renewed hostilities follow a brief lull in the ongoing conflict.

stories.headline: Polish PM Says Crater‑Making Missile Near Tarnawa Likely Russian
stories.summary: Poland’s prime minister says the missile that created a 10‑meter crater near Tarnawa Kolonia was likely Russian. The incident underscores the spillover risks of the war in neighboring Ukraine.

stories.headline: Sibling Duo Crafts Warm, Familiar Folk-Pop Gems
stories.summary: The Philadelphia sibling duo's third album is a collection of folk-pop songs that are both soothing and slightly surreal. Their music is a perfect blend of warmth and familiarity.

stories.headline: Mancunian Producer Animates Foreboding Bass Music
stories.summary: The Mancunian producer's debut on Peak Oil label is a masterclass in creating foreboding, percussive bass music with intricate details and complex grooves. His music is a thrilling experience for fans of electronic music.

stories.headline: Distilling DeepSeek into GPT-OSS Yields Surprising Results
stories.summary: Researchers have successfully distilled DeepSeek into GPT-OSS, resulting in a model that outperforms existing models on finance tasks. The self-distilled model achieved an impressive 83.61% accuracy on FinanceReasoning.

stories.headline: Russian Missile Attack Claims Lives of Family Members
stories.summary: A devastating Russian missile attack has killed at least five members of the same family, including a six-year-old girl and two boys. The attack occurred in a village near the central city of Kryvyi Rih.

stories.headline: GPT 5.6 Sol Runs Amok in Autonomously Run Business
stories.summary: A team of researchers gave GPT 5.6 Sol control of a real business, but the AI's actions resulted in significant losses, including $447 in damages. The experiment highlights the potential risks of autonomous AI systems.

stories.headline: Solving Poker in Custom WebGPU Kernels
stories.summary: A developer has successfully implemented a poker solver in custom WebGPU kernels, demonstrating the potential of this technology for complex computations. The solver uses WebGPU's parallel processing capabilities to achieve high performance.

stories.headline: Gemini Robotics 2 Brings Whole-Body Intelligence to Robots
stories.summary: DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2 system enables robots to learn and adapt in a more human-like way, with whole-body intelligence that allows them to interact with their environment in a more natural manner. This technology has significant implications for robotics and AI research.

stories.headline: UEFA and National Associations Boycott FIFA Competitions
stories.summary: In an unprecedented move, UEFA and its national associations have announced that they will boycott FIFA competitions unless the organization reverses a controversial deal to sell minority stakes. This decision has significant implications for the future of international soccer.

stories.headline: European Soccer Leaders Boycott World Cup in Protest
stories.summary: European soccer associations have announced that they will boycott the World Cup unless FIFA reverses a deal to sell minority stakes in the tournament. This decision is a significant escalation of the dispute between UEFA and FIFA.

stories.headline: Trump Announces Agreement on Hamas Disarmament
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump has announced that the Board of Peace has reached an agreement with Hamas on the disarmament of the Palestinian militant group. However, Israel and Hamas have yet to comment on the announcement.

stories.headline: Apple Issues Minor Updates Ahead of Major Overhaul
stories.summary: Apple has released a series of minor updates for its operating systems, including iOS and macOS, which are likely the last before major updates arrive. These updates include bug fixes and security patches.

stories.headline: Apple's iPhone Upgrade Plan Exposed as a Lease
stories.summary: Apple's new iPhone upgrade plan, called Apple Upgrade, has been revealed to be a lease rather than a traditional upgrade program, leaving consumers with potential long-term financial obligations.

stories.headline: Iran May Prefer Limited War with US to Peace
stories.summary: Iran may believe that engaging in a limited war with the US is a more desirable option than achieving peace, as it allows the country to maintain pressure on its adversary without risking an all-out conflict.

stories.headline: Apple Upgrade Program vs. iPhone Upgrade Program: What's the Difference?
stories.summary: Apple's new Apple Upgrade program has replaced the iPhone Upgrade Program, but despite similarities, the two offerings have key differences that consumers should be aware of.

stories.headline: Toxic Pesticide Suspected in Mass Elephant Deaths in Kenya
stories.summary: Fifteen elephants have died in southern Kenya, and officials suspect that a toxic pesticide used on tomatoes may be to blame, with foul play ruled out as a cause.

stories.headline: Trump Considers AI Regulations After OpenAI Hacking Incidents
stories.summary: The Trump administration is considering implementing regulations on AI technology after a series of hacking incidents involving OpenAI, marking a shift in its approach to the technology.

stories.headline: A La Carte: A Collection of Christian Perspectives and Insights
stories.summary: This week's A La Carte features a range of articles and book reviews on topics including church growth, missions, and biblical respect in a disrespectful age.

stories.headline: Uefa Threatens to Boycott World Cups Over FIFA Investment Plans
stories.summary: Uefa has voted to boycott future World Cups if FIFA and its president, Gianni Infantino, do not back down on their investment proposals, with the organization declaring that the World Cup is 'not for sale'.

stories.headline: Mark Zuckerberg Envisions an AI Future for Everyone
stories.summary: Mark Zuckerberg has written an op-ed piece in The Wall Street Journal, arguing that the benefits of AI technology should be available to everyone, despite the need for paid subscriptions to access some of its features.

stories.headline: Rune 1.1 Released with New Features and Free Access
stories.summary: Rune, an Emacs editor, has released version 1.1, which includes new features such as Python support, a symbol index, and is now available for free.

stories.headline: Fauci Hearings Spark Fears of Public Health Brain Drain
stories.summary: Experts warn that the backlash against Dr. Anthony Fauci could lead to a shortage of skilled public health professionals in the US. The loss of talent would be a significant blow to the country's ability to respond to future health crises.

stories.headline: Migrant Influx Overwhelms Spanish Enclave
stories.summary: Hundreds of migrants have swum from Morocco to Ceuta, straining the territory's resources and prompting calls for Spanish government intervention. The influx has raised concerns about the enclave's ability to cope with the surge in arrivals.

stories.headline: US Economy Slows, But Consumer Spending Remains Strong
stories.summary: The US economy grew at an annual rate of 1.5% in the spring, a modest slowdown from the previous quarter. Despite the slowdown, consumer spending continued to drive growth, suggesting a resilient US consumer.

stories.headline: CodePen 2.0 Revolutionizes Web Development
stories.summary: CodePen has launched a major update, offering a range of new features and improvements for web developers. The update aims to make it easier for developers to create, test, and showcase their work.

stories.headline: Danube Drought Forces Shutdown of Hungary's Nuclear Plant
stories.summary: A prolonged drought has forced the shutdown of Hungary's only nuclear plant, highlighting the impact of climate change on European water supplies. Romania, Bulgaria, and Serbia are also struggling with the effects of the drought.

stories.headline: Fauci Faces Contempt Charges as Asylum Rule Changes Spark Outrage
stories.summary: Sen. Rand Paul is moving to hold Dr. Anthony Fauci in contempt of Congress, while a new rule announced by the Trump administration has sparked outrage among asylum seekers. The rule change aims to make it harder for migrants to claim asylum in the US.

stories.headline: Think Twice Before Buying That TV Streaming Stick
stories.summary: A recent article warns that TV streaming sticks can be a security risk, highlighting the need for consumers to be cautious when purchasing these devices. The article offers tips and advice for staying safe while streaming.

stories.headline: Nicaraguan Leader Seeks to Extend Presidential Term
stories.summary: Nicaraguan President Daniel Ortega has proposed extending his presidential term by another year, sparking concerns about the country's democratic process. The move is the latest in a series of constitutional amendments aimed at allowing Ortega to stay in power.

stories.headline: Wildfires Rage on Greek Island of Crete
stories.summary: Thousands of people have been evacuated from the Greek island of Crete as wildfires continue to spread, threatening tourist resorts and local communities. Strong winds have fanned the flames, making it harder for firefighters to contain the blaze.

stories.headline: Migrants Swim Around Ceuta Border Fence
stories.summary: Hundreds of migrants have been seen swimming around the border fence of the Spanish enclave of Ceuta, highlighting the ongoing migrant crisis in the region. The influx has put a strain on the enclave's resources and prompted calls for Spanish government intervention.

stories.headline: Mortgage rates climb to 6.66%, highest in a year amid war and inflation fears
stories.summary: The average 30‑year fixed mortgage hit 6.66% on Thursday, the steepest level in twelve months. Analysts link the jump to heightened geopolitical tension and persistent inflation pressures.

stories.headline: Rogue Amoeba’s Sparkle update alerts annoy users by popping up at worst moments
stories.summary: The company’s Sparkle framework, while reliable, often displays update notices right after an app launches. Users report that the timing interrupts critical tasks like starting a recording in Audio Hijack.

stories.headline: Trump signals possible temporary pullback of Blanche AG nomination
stories.summary: The president hinted he may suspend the nomination while two senior Republicans withhold support. Their hesitation stems from concerns over a Justice Department agreement with Trump.

stories.headline: GitHub rolls out stacked pull requests in public preview
stories.summary: Developers can now group related PRs into a single stack, simplifying complex code reviews. The feature is available now for testing on the platform.

stories.headline: Ugandan opposition veteran collapses in court, rushed to ICU
stories.summary: The 70‑year‑old leader, detained since November 2024 on treason charges he denies, fell ill during a hearing. His wife confirmed he is now receiving intensive care.

stories.headline: Australia sues Telegram over alleged failure to delete pro‑terror content
stories.summary: The government claims the messaging app did not act on material promoting terrorism. Telegram rejects the accusation and says it will contest the case in court.

stories.headline: Study quantifies the financial upside of systematic code refactoring
stories.summary: The article argues that regular refactoring, especially with generative AI assistance, can cut maintenance costs and accelerate delivery. It presents a model showing measurable ROI for disciplined teams.

stories.headline: Giant iceberg capsizes off Greenland, generating massive wave
stories.summary: A passerby captured video of a colossal iceberg overturning near the coast, sending a towering wave outward. The event highlights the dynamic instability of large ice masses in warming seas.

stories.headline: Japanese mall collapses after 6.8‑magnitude quake, rescue ops ongoing
stories.summary: An Aeon shopping centre was reduced to rubble following a powerful earthquake, prompting a large‑scale search for survivors. Authorities continue to comb the debris for victims.

stories.headline: Physicists resolve muon anomaly, casting doubt on earlier results
stories.summary: New measurements have clarified the long‑standing muon discrepancy, making previous experimental findings inconsistent. The breakthrough forces a re‑examination of past data and theoretical models.
